title: Recording leaked to Globo and the case ridiculed

tellings.quote: it, he leaked the recording at the time to a TV network called Globu in Brazil. And this network every time would ridicule the case,

plain: Carlos de Souza says that around 1996 and 1997 a recording tied to a Brazilian creature case was leaked to Globo, a big Brazilian TV network, and that the network, on its show Fantástico, ridiculed the case every time. He tells Michels this as someone involved at the time and mentions a person named Claudia Kovu. In his telling it shows how national television treated the case with mockery.
